page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU core. It does not include integrated local NVMe or block storage, relying instead on network-attached storage options, and contains no discrete GPU hardware accelerators. Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

With an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, the resource balance prioritizes high-density system memory over localized storage or accelerated graphics. The lack of onboard local disks requires external storage volumes for persistent data retention, introducing network latency considerations for storage-bound processes. However, the high capacity of dedicated system RAM and 32 Gbps network interface provide high resource density for workloads operating entirely in memory. Qualitative cost efficiency is aligned with enterprise memory scale operations, where consolidating large datasets into a single instance memory footprint reduces distributed node overhead. Suitable application scenarios include in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and batch data processing jobs.
